label: after
head: 1a39332a
scope: what the engine writes to its oxygen numbers around the bench; diagnosis, not acceptance

A1_upper_write_is_the_full_demand_becaus.discriminates: which branch of the upper-layer sink runs in the open bench room, and why
A1_upper_write_is_the_full_demand_becaus.confirms: every powered step takes the branch full_thornton, the probe says the sink does not see two zones, and with that flag set in the oxygen system alone every step takes displacement
A1_upper_write_is_the_full_demand_becaus.refutes: another branch, or the same branch with the flag set

A2_upper_and_room_numbers_overlap_and_ar.discriminates: whether the second write debits an independent inventory
A2_upper_and_room_numbers_overlap_and_ar.confirms: its mass base is the room air mass times a geometric fraction, the same room air the first debit already used, and the room number is not kept equal to the weighted layers
A2_upper_and_room_numbers_overlap_and_ar.refutes: disjoint bases whose weighted numbers always return the room number

A3_upper_write_does_not_reach_the_room_i.discriminates: whether the second write feeds back into the contracted debit or the accepted energy
A3_upper_write_does_not_reach_the_room_i.confirms: with the other branch the room oxygen number and the applied power are identical bit by bit over the whole run, and so are the accepted energy and the contracted debit
A3_upper_write_does_not_reach_the_room_i.refutes: any difference in the room number, the power or the accepted energy

A4_upper_write_reaches_the_regime_indica.discriminates: whether the second write can change when the bench leaves its regime
A4_upper_write_reaches_the_regime_indica.confirms: the lowest upper and lower numbers differ between the two branches
A4_upper_write_reaches_the_regime_indica.refutes: the same lower number with both branches

A5_the_all_sinks_counter_is_a_sum_of_ove.discriminates: what the kilograms published as a second debit measure
A5_the_all_sinks_counter_is_a_sum_of_ove.confirms: all-sinks minus primary equals what the upper sink applied; in the open room it equals the contracted debit itself, so the sum is twice one consumption
A5_the_all_sinks_counter_is_a_sum_of_ove.refutes: a counter that matches an independent state change

A6_requested_applied_and_state_change_ar.discriminates: whether what a sink asks, what it applies and what its number shows can differ
A6_requested_applied_and_state_change_ar.confirms: they are reported apart and their differences, if any, are explained by a cap or a clamp
A6_requested_applied_and_state_change_ar.what_it_means: kg of the upper number are kg on the upper base; they are listed beside the room inventory, never added to it

B1_no_source_and_zero_energy_are_the_sam.discriminates: whether the source has any oxygen channel other than the room power
B1_no_source_and_zero_energy_are_the_sam.confirms: six numbers per step identical bit by bit over 120 steps

B2_in_a_sealed_room_the_sink_takes_anoth.discriminates: which route ran at the rejected step and on which numbers
B2_in_a_sealed_room_the_sink_takes_anoth.confirms: plume_lower route, nothing applied to the room inventory, a write on the lower number and one on the upper number, and the room number recomposed from the layers
B2_in_a_sealed_room_the_sink_takes_anoth.refutes: the room-inventory route, or no write at all

B3_a_rejected_step_leaves_no_trace_of_th.discriminates: whether a rejected interval changes the room beside its twin without source
B3_a_rejected_step_leaves_no_trace_of_th.confirms: every oxygen number identical to the twin at every step, no heat, nothing accepted
B3_a_rejected_step_leaves_no_trace_of_th.refutes: any step whose numbers differ from the twin

B4_the_trace_scales_with_the_energy_of_t.discriminates: whether what is left behind is the debit of the first interval
B4_the_trace_scales_with_the_energy_of_t.confirms: the plume debit of step 0 equals the energy of that interval times the coefficient, for two steps
B4_the_trace_scales_with_the_energy_of_t.refutes: a trace unrelated to that energy

B5_after_leaving_the_regime_by_a_rule_no.discriminates: whether an exit decided before the power is written leaves a debit
B5_after_leaving_the_regime_by_a_rule_no.confirms: from the exit step on every sink counter is zero, also after the oxygen is restored
